analyticalQuestion: Can two smooth Navier-Stokes initial data with the same local strain and normalized vorticity covariance have opposite source-shape correlation derivatives?
takeaway: Yes. The exact matched pair has identical local, viscous, and covariance-shape contributions; the pressure Hessian alone switches the sign of qdot.
